editorial.headline: Natural Asphalt Mining With a Clear PMA Route
editorial.standfirst: KBLI 08993 covers natural asphalt, asphalt-bearing stone, and solid natural bitumen, with national PMA openness and no Bali moratorium block in this record.
editorial.body:
KBLI 08993 is a mining classification, not a trading or construction label. Its Indonesian scope is focused on the extraction of natural asphalt, asphalt-bearing stone, and solid natural bitumen. The record also includes separation and pouring activities for those minerals, so the centre of gravity is the mineral activity itself: taking the material from its natural source and handling the mineral in the forms named by the scope.

That makes this a specialised code for businesses whose registered activity is tied to natural asphalt and bitumen as minerals. The slim record opens the code across all listed business scales: Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, and Besar. It also carries the licensing language shown in the source field, namely IUPK Exploration and extension of IUP at the Production Operation stage. Those references should be read exactly as they appear in the record: they signal the mining character of the activity, without adding any separate threshold, timeline, or capital rule beyond the slim data.

At the national level, the PMA position is uncomplicated. This record marks PMA as TERBUKA and sets the foreign-ownership ceiling at 100%. In plain terms, the national investment list source named here treats the activity as open to foreign ownership up to the full ceiling recorded for this code. There is no partial foreign cap to explain for this record, and no basis here to introduce a special ownership restriction beyond the stated maximum.

The Bali reading is also unusually clean, because the record does not show a provincial PMA block. Bali’s moratorium rule blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI for PMA, island-wide and permanently. But this record says the OSS risk at Besar scale is Menengah-Tinggi/Tinggi, and therefore it is not blocked by that moratorium. The honest conclusion is that KBLI 08993 is nationally open for PMA and, on this slim record, not blocked for PMA registration in Bali by the stated Bali moratorium rule.
